# Independent E-Commerce Business

## Overview

Operate an independent online reselling business through platforms like Depop and eBay with over 280 completed sales. The business involves managing every stage of the process independently, from sourcing inventory to customer communication and fulfillment.

## Responsibilities

- Product sourcing and trend analysis  
- Pricing strategy and listing optimization  
- Product photography and visual branding  
- Customer communication and fulfillment logistics  
- Inventory management and platform operations  

## Skills Used

E-commerce, branding, analytics, consumer behavior, Photoshop, operations, digital marketing

- Organizational communication workflows  
- Brand success and operational strategy
